<summary>📝 Walkthrough</summary>

## Walkthrough

Generation Worker 现在通过应用注入生成与续跑执行器。重启恢复、视频续跑和失败编码被拆到独立模块。正式图片提交流程迁移到 `formal_image_commit`，相关服务端调用与测试同步更新。

### Changes

**生成 Worker 与恢复流程**

|Layer / File(s)|Summary|
|---|---|
|**Worker 装配与生命周期** <br> `lib/generation/generation_worker.py`, `server/app.py`, `tests/integration/lib/generation/*`, `tests/unit/lib/generation/*`|`GenerationWorker` 要求显式传入 `executor` 与 `resume_executor`。Worker 将启动孤儿处理、调用结算和派发等待委托给 `_recovery`。|
|**重启恢复与视频续跑** <br> `lib/generation/restart_recovery.py`, `lib/generation/video_resume.py`, `tests/integration/lib/generation/test_restart_recovery.py`, `tests/integration/lib/generation/test_video_resume.py`|新增孤儿扫描、provider 分桶、容量限制、续跑执行、staging 清理和调用结算逻辑。测试覆盖失败、取消、容量为零、并发限制和本进程任务保护。|
|**任务失败编码** <br> `lib/generation/task_failure_encoding.py`, `tests/integration/lib/generation/test_task_failure_capability.py`, `tests/unit/lib/custom_provider/*`|新增 `encode_task_failure_message`。结构化编码失败时记录 warning，并按异常类型回退到固定编码或异常文本。|
|**正式图片提交管线** <br> `server/services/tasks/formal_image_commit.py`, `server/services/tasks/generation_tasks.py`, `server/services/tasks/image_edit_tasks.py`, `server/services/tasks/derivative_sheet_tasks.py`|新增公开的正式图片提交、最终化、资产表、分镜和网格接口。任务入口删除重复实现，并改用共享接口。|
|**依赖边界与验证** <br> `pyproject.toml`, `website/docs/dev/architecture.md`, `tests/integration/test_imports.py`, `scripts/audit_tests.py`, `tests/*`|核心库不依赖服务端的契约移除两条豁免。应用装配、导入检查、测试替身和 monkeypatch 目标同步更新。|
